newsitem.title: CHINA: China PICC Property insures Ling'ao nuclear plant.
newsitem.headline: China PICC Property insures Ling'ao nuclear plant.

text.p: The People's Insurance Company of China Property has agreed to offer $1.2 billion insurance cover for the Ling'ao nuclear power station in the southern province of Guangdong, the Financial Morning Post said on Monday.
PICC Property, a unit of PICC Group, recently signed a contract with Ling'ao in the southern city of Shenzhen, the newspaper said.
PICC Property would provide all-risk insurance cover for ocean shipping works at the project, it said.
The plant will be equipped with four 1,000-megawatt reactors. The first unit will be put into commercial operation by July 2002, while the second unit will be operational by March 2003.
The PICC Group has offered more than $2 billion insurance cover for the project since 1984, which also involves the nearby Daya Bay plant, the newspaper said but gave no further details.
